selection_rule: First successful full audio downloaded by Sol in its authoritative log, selected before examining its final submission.
edits: Use source t=0, continuous 80s and 20s excerpts. Loudness normalization only. No musical reordering, crossfade or designed ending. Hard stop at picture end.
purpose: Descriptive auxiliary comparator, not a known-bad ground-truth artistic score or an expert calibration.
scoring: Same explicit audio+silent video route and original coefficient prompts as submission; up to three remaining calls after main review within shared total cap12. No further calls when cap exhausted.
